questions._solutionHtml:
A) 1/8. The water forms a cone similar to the full cup with scale factor ½ (half the depth, so half the radius as well). Volume scales as the cube of the scale factor: (½)³ = 1/8. (D assumes volume scales with depth; C squares instead of cubes; B splits the difference.)
Banding: B6 — the similar-cone-within-a-cone and the scale³ effect on volume must both be RECOGNIZED (nothing to plug in); rubric places scale-factor impact on volume at B6.
Modal avoided: cone volume plug-in from radius and height (banned realization).
